description: Letter from Georgia O'Keeffe to Claudia O'Keeffe. Enclosed is a letter from Ruth West Campbell to Mrs. R. Sampson Low regarding the Mensendieck System and excercises for children. Georgia O'Keeffe writes that Dr. Mensendieck gave her a copy of the letter.
imageCaption: Letter from Georgia O'Keeffe to Claudia O'Keeffe, undated. Claudia O'Keeffe Papers. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. © Georgia O'Keeffe Museum.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe to Claudia O'Keeffe
